title: 應變矽通道整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 應變與輸運
stages.description: 在「應變與輸運」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for strain and transport, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 應力與應變
steps.objective: 完成「應力與應變」的因果圖，把應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate stress and strain, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：應力與應變。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂小應變：長度由 100.00 變為 100.10 單位；計算軸向應變，再說明為何缺少彈性常數及邊界條件時不能唯一求應力。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate stress and strain. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical small strain: length changes from 100.00 to 100.10 units. Calculate axial strain and explain why stress is not uniquely known without elastic constants and boundaries.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「應力與應變」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate stress and strain and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「應力與應變」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate stress and strain: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

knowledge.title: 應力與應變的原理
knowledge.text: 應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。
knowledge.textEn: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 應變對輸運的作用依賴方向、載子及能帶；「增加應力」沒有脫離方向與材料的普遍正面意義。
knowledge.textEn: Strain effects depend on direction, carriers and bands; increasing stress has no universal benefit independent of material and direction.

quiz.question: 評估「應力與應變」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate stress and strain?
options: 應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。
沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。
厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。 應變對輸運的作用依賴方向、載子及能帶；「增加應力」沒有脫離方向與材料的普遍正面意義。
quiz.explanationEn: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. Strain effects depend on direction, carriers and bands; increasing stress has no universal benefit independent of material and direction.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Register channel orientation. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Mobility response depends on orientation and carrier type. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「遷移率對應變的反應依賴晶向與載子種類。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Mobility response depends on orientation and carrier type. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「通道晶向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for register channel orientation and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「通道晶向」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for register channel orientation: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：拉伸與壓縮。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：同一應變符號對電子與電洞未必同樣有利。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare tension and compression. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: One strain sign need not benefit electrons and holes equally. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「同一應變符號對電子與電洞未必同樣有利。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「拉伸與壓縮」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for compare tension and compression: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.title: 張量分量

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for resolve strain components, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：張量分量。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：單一數值不能代表完整三維應變。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Resolve strain components. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: One scalar cannot represent full three-dimensional strain. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「單一數值不能代表完整三維應變。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「張量分量」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for resolve strain components: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a measurement plan for choose a reference device, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：基準元件。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：比較需維持幾何、電壓與接觸條件一致。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Choose a reference device. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Comparisons require matched geometry, voltage and contacts. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「比較需維持幾何、電壓與接觸條件一致。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

Interpretation: Drive current is also constrained by series resistance and capacitance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

quiz.explanationEn: Drive current is also constrained by series resistance and capacitance. Strain effects depend on direction, carriers and bands; increasing stress has no universal benefit independent of material and direction.
